tournament_archive.name: WMH | 2024 Masters World Cup | Auckland, New Zealand
tournament_archive.location: National Hockey Centre, Auckland, New Zealand
tournament_archive.description:
WMH is thrilled with the number of registered teams for the WMH World Cup, 2024. 113 teams registered for Cape Town and 141 for Auckland, including 33 International Masters Cup teams. We were there with our Hong Kong Masters MO50 team. We had an awesome time!

View all the Auckland matches here (free login required): **https://www.worldmastershockey.tv/en/home**
